description: Send a notification email when a new Account is created in Dataverse.
note: This is a reference schema for documentation purposes. Import via Power Automate > My flows > Import, or recreate manually.

parameters.Subject: @{outputs('compose_subject')}
parameters.Body:
A new account has been created:

  • Name: @{triggerOutputs()?['body/name']}
  • Phone: @{triggerOutputs()?['body/telephone1']}
  • Created by: @{triggerOutputs()?['body/_createdby_value@OData.Community.Display.V1.FormattedValue']}
